entries.text: In Ferreira's opinion, the preservation of plastic artifacts ___. entries.title: The percentage of UK graduates in non-graduate roles reflects ___.
entries.text: The percentage of UK graduates in non-graduate roles reflects ___. [A] millennials' opinions about work 千禧一代对工作看法 [B] the shrinking value of degree [C] public discount with education 公众对教育的轻视 [D] the desired route of social mobility 期望的社会流动路径 答案 B The percentage of UK graduates in non-graduate roles reflects ___.英国毕业生担任非研究生职位的百分比反映了___。 [A] millennials' opinions about work千禧一代对工作看法 [B] the shrinking value of degree [C] public discount with education公众对教育的轻视 [D] the desired route of social mobility期望的社会流动路径 💡 考场思路第二段："As degrees became universal, they became devalued." 28%毕业生从事非毕业生岗位，正是学位贬值的体现。

entries.title: The author considers it a good sign that ___.
entries.text: The author considers it a good sign that ___. [A] Generation Z are seeking to earn a decent degree Z世代正努力获得一个体面的学位 [B] school leavers are willing to be skilled workers 离校生愿意成为技术工人 [C] employers are taking a realistic attitude to degrees [D] parents are changing their minds about education 父母正在改变对教育的看法 答案 C The author considers it a good sign that ___.作者认为这是一个好兆头，即___。 [A] Generation Z are seeking to earn a decent degreeZ世代正努力获得一个体面的学位 [B] school leavers are willing to be skilled workers离校生愿意成为技术工人 [C] employers are taking a realistic attitude to degrees [D] parents are changing their minds about education父母正在改变对教育的看法 💡 考场思路第四段 Thankfully 后面：雇主看到招聘中学毕业生的好处、取消某些岗位学位要求——这是雇主对学位采取务实态度的好迹象。

entries.title: It is advised in Paragraph 5 that those with one degree should ___.
entries.text: It is advised in Paragraph 5 that those with one degree should ___. [A] make an early decision on their career 尽早对职业做出决定 [B] attend on-the-job training programs 参加在职培训项目 [C] team up with high-paid post graduates 与高薪研究生合作 [D] further their studies in the specific field 答案 D It is advised in Paragraph 5 that those with one degree should ___.在第5段中，建议具有一个学位的人应___。 [A] make an early decision on their career尽早对职业做出决定 [B] attend on-the-job training programs参加在职培训项目 [C] team up with high-paid post graduates与高薪研究生合作 [D] further their studies in the specific field 💡 考场思路第五段末："it makes sense to have two"——再读一个学位，即在特定领域继续深造。

entries.title: What can be concluded about Generation Z from last two paragraphs?
entries.text: What can be concluded about Generation Z from last two paragraphs? [A] Lifelong learning will define them. [B] They will make qualified educators. 他们将能成为合格的教育者。 [C] Degrees will no longer appeal to them. 学位将不再吸引他们。 [D] They will have a limited choice of jobs. 他们将只有有限的就业选择。 答案 A What can be concluded about Generation Z from last two paragraphs?从最后两段可以得出什么关于Z世代的结论？ [A] Lifelong learning will define them. [B] They will make qualified educators.他们将能成为合格的教育者。 [C] Degrees will no longer appeal to them.学位将不再吸引他们。 [D] They will have a limited choice of jobs.他们将只有有限的就业选择。 💡 考场思路倒数第二段："they will need to be constantly up-skilling throughout their career"——不断提升技能=终身学习定义他们。

entries.title: According to Paragraph 1, art-science collaborations have ___.
entries.text: According to Paragraph 1, art-science collaborations have ___. [A] caught the attention of critics 引起了评论家的注意 [B] received favorable responses [C] promoted academic publishing 推动了学术出版 [D] sparked heated public disputes 引发了激烈的社会争论 答案 B According to Paragraph 1, art-science collaborations have ___.根据第1段，艺术-科学合作有___。 [A] caught the attention of critics引起了评论家的注意 [B] received favorable responses [C] promoted academic publishing推动了学术出版 [D] sparked heated public disputes引发了激烈的社会争论 💡 考场思路第一段用 Enlightening, stimulating, inspiring, fun 等正面词描述合作体验，近40%的人合作过，几乎所有人未来愿意合作——积极回应。 逐项分析 [A] 引起批评家注意 → 未提 critics； [B] 获得积极回应 → 正确； [C] 促进学术出版 → 未提及； [D] 引发公众争论 → 与 encouraging 相反。 核心词汇 collaboration n. 合作 engage v. 参与 two-way street 双向的 shared stake 共同利益 alliance n. 联盟 stereotype v. 刻板印象

entries.title: The reworked version of The Four Seasons is mentioned to show that ___.
entries.text: The reworked version of The Four Seasons is mentioned to show that ___. [A] art can offer audiences easy access to science [B] science can help with the expression of emotions 科学有助于情感的表达 [C] public participation in science has a promising future 公众参与科学前景可期 [D] art is effective in facilitating scientific innovation 艺术能有效促进科学创新 答案 A The reworked version of The Four Seasons is mentioned to show that ___.提到了《四季》的翻新版本，以表明___。 [A] art can offer audiences easy access to science [B] science can help with the expression of emotions科学有助于情感的表达 [C] public participation in science has a promising future公众参与科学前景可期 [D] art is effective in facilitating scientific innovation艺术能有效促进科学创新 💡 考场思路例证题找论点。第二段论点：科学家找艺术家帮助"communicate their work to new audiences"。用维瓦尔第《四季》改编注入气候数据，正是艺术让公众接触科学。 逐项分析 [A] 艺术让观众轻松接触科学 → 正确； [B] 科学帮助表达情感 → 与文意相反； [C] 公众参与科学前景光明 → 偷换； [D] 艺术促进科学创新 → 未提及。

entries.title: Some artists seem to worry that in the art-science partnership ___.
entries.text: Some artists seem to worry that in the art-science partnership ___. [A] their roles may be underestimated [B] their reputation may be impaired 他们的声誉可能受损 [C] their creativity may be inhibited 他们的创造力可能受抑制 [D] their work may be misguided 他们的工作可能受到误导 答案 A Some artists seem to worry that in the art-science partnership ___.一些艺术家似乎担心在艺术-科学伙伴关系中___。 [A] their roles may be underestimated [B] their reputation may be impaired他们的声誉可能受损 [C] their creativity may be inhibited他们的创造力可能受抑制 [D] their work may be misguided他们的工作可能受到误导 💡 考场思路第四段："artists do not simply assist scientists... Nor should their work be considered only as an object of study"——艺术家担心自己只是助手、作品只是研究对象，即角色被低估。

entries.title: What does the author say about CAVS?
entries.text: What does the author say about CAVS? [A] It was headed alternately by artists and scientists. 它由艺术家和科学家交替领导。 [B] It exemplified valuable art-science alliances. [C] Its projects aimed at advancing visual studies. 其旨在推进视觉研究的项目。 [D] Its founders sought to raise the status of artists. 其创始人试图提升艺术家的地位。 答案 B What does the author say about CAVS?作者对CAVS有什么看法？ [A] It was headed alternately by artists and scientists.它由艺术家和科学家交替领导。 [B] It exemplified valuable art-science alliances. [C] Its projects aimed at advancing visual studies.其旨在推进视觉研究的项目。 [D] Its founders sought to raise the status of artists.其创始人试图提升艺术家的地位。 💡 考场思路第五段讲CAVS由艺术家和科学家共同创建，致力于创造更人道世界——这是有价值的艺术-科学联盟的典范。

entries.title: In the last paragraph, the author holds art-science collaborations ___.
entries.text: In the last paragraph, the author holds art-science collaborations ___. [A] are likely to go beyond public expectations 可能超出公众预期 [B] will intensify interdisciplinary competition 将加剧跨学科竞争 [C] should do more than communicating science [D] are becoming more popular than before 正变得比以前更受欢迎 答案 C In the last paragraph, the author holds art-science collaborations ___.在最后一段中，作者持有艺术-科学合作___。 [A] are likely to go beyond public expectations可能超出公众预期 [B] will intensify interdisciplinary competition将加剧跨学科竞争 [C] should do more than communicating science [D] are becoming more popular than before正变得比以前更受欢迎 💡 考场思路末段首句："The reach of art-science tie-ups needs to go beyond the necessary purpose of research communication"——合作应超越研究传播的目的，即做更多事。

entries.title: The personal grievance provisions of the ERA are intended to ___.
entries.text: The personal grievance provisions of the ERA are intended to ___. [A] punish dubious corporate practices 惩处可疑的企业行为 [B] improve traditional hiring procedures 改进传统的招聘流程。 [C] exempt employers from certain duties 使雇主免除某些义务 [D] protect the rights of ordinary workers 答案 D The personal grievance provisions of the ERA are intended to ___.ERA的个人申诉条款旨在___。 [A] punish dubious corporate practices惩处可疑的企业行为 [B] improve traditional hiring procedures改进传统的招聘流程。 [C] exempt employers from certain duties使雇主免除某些义务 [D] protect the rights of ordinary workers 💡 考场思路第二段首句："Personal grievance procedures were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from 'unjustified dismissals'." 保护普通工人工作。 逐项分析 [A] 惩罚可疑企业行为 → 未提及； [B] 改善传统招聘流程 → 与 firing 无关； [C] 免除雇主义务 → 与文意相反； [D] 保护普通工人权利 → 正确。 核心词汇 grievance n. 申诉/不满 arbitrary adj. 任意的 mediocrity n. 平庸 paradox n. 悖论 stringent adj. 严格的 unwieldy adj. 难操作的

entries.title: It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that the provision may ___.
entries.text: It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that the provision may ___. [A] hinder business development [B] undermine the managers' authorities 削弱经理人的权威 [C] affect the public image of the firms 影响企业的公众形象 [D] weaken the labor-management relations 削弱劳资关系 答案 A It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that the provision may ___.从第3款中可以了解到，该条款可以___。 [A] hinder business development [B] undermine the managers' authorities削弱经理人的权威 [C] affect the public image of the firms影响企业的公众形象 [D] weaken the labor-management relations削弱劳资关系 💡 考场思路第三段："constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity"——限制解雇差经理就像踩手刹，阻碍生产率提高，即阻碍企业发展。

entries.title: Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support?
entries.text: Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support? [A] Imposing reasonable wage restraints. 施加合理的工资限制。 [B] Enforcing employment protections. 执行就业保护。 [C] Limiting the powers of business owners. 限制企业主的权力。 [D] Dismissing poorly performing managers. 答案 D Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support?生产力委员会将支持以下哪些措施？ [A] Imposing reasonable wage restraints.施加合理的工资限制。 [B] Enforcing employment protections.执行就业保护。 [C] Limiting the powers of business owners.限制企业主的权力。 [D] Dismissing poorly performing managers. 💡 考场思路第五段：生产力委员会指出管理能力低下是生产率差的原因。言下之意，应该解雇表现差的经理。

entries.title: What might be an effect of ERA's unjustified dismissal procedure?
entries.text: What might be an effect of ERA's unjustified dismissal procedure? [A] High-paid managers may lose jobs. 高薪经理可能失去工作。 [B] Employees suffer salary cut. [C] Society sees a rise in well-being. 社会福祉有所提升。 [D] Employers hire more staff. 雇主雇佣更多员工。 答案 B What might be an effect of ERA's unjustified dismissal procedure?ERA 的不当驳回程序可能会产生什么影响？ [A] High-paid managers may lose jobs.高薪经理可能失去工作。 [B] Employees suffer salary cut. [C] Society sees a rise in well-being.社会福祉有所提升。 [D] Employers hire more staff.雇主雇佣更多员工。 💡 考场思路第六段末："firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong"——公司给员工工资更低。

entries.title: It can be inferred that "high-income threshold" in Australia ___.
entries.text: It can be inferred that "high-income threshold" in Australia ___. [A] has secured managers' earnings 已锁定经理人的收益 [B] has produced undesired results 产生了事与愿违的结果 [C] is beneficial to business owners 对企业主有益 [D] is difficult to put into practice 答案 D It can be inferred that "high-income threshold" in Australia ___.可以推断，澳大利亚的“高收入门槛” ___。 [A] has secured managers' earnings已锁定经理人的收益 [B] has produced undesired results产生了事与愿违的结果 [C] is beneficial to business owners对企业主有益 [D] is difficult to put into practice 💡 考场思路最后一段：新西兰试图效仿澳大利亚做法，但"the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy"（提出的机制难以操作），法案被否决——暗指澳大利亚的高收入门槛在实践中也难以操作。

entries.title: 【题目】阅读关于"反对动物园"文章的五位评论者观点，从A–G中为(41)–(45)匹配观点。两个多余选项。
entries.text: 【题目】阅读关于"反对动物园"文章的五位评论者观点，从A–G中为(41)–(45)匹配观点。两个多余选项。 答案 F 【题目】阅读关于"反对动物园"文章的五位评论者观点，从A–G中为(41)–(45)匹配观点。两个多余选项。 匹配[F] 动物园应该被关闭，因为它们把赚钱置于动物福祉之上。→ 对应Byrd说"profitable institutions whose bottom line is much more important"和"eliminate zoos from our culture"。 Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G AZoos which spare no effort to take care of animals should not be subjected to unfair criticism.不遗余力照料动物的动物园，不应遭受不公正的批评。 BTo pressure zoos to spend less on their animals would lead to inhumane outcomes for the precious creatures in their care.迫使动物园减少对动物的投入，会给它们所照管的珍贵生灵带来不人道的后果。 CWhile animals in captivity deserve sympathy, zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.尽管圈养动物值得同情，但动物园在引导年轻人走上相关科学之路上发挥着重要作用。 DZoos save people trips to wilderness areas and thus contribute to wildlife conservation.动物园让人们省去前往荒野的奔波，从而有助于野生动物保护。 EFor wild

entries.title: It was also, and this is unknown even to many people well read about the period,
entries.text: It was also, and this is unknown even to many people well read about the period, a battle between those who made codes and those who broke them. It was also, and this is unknown even to many people well read about the period, a battle between those who made codes and those who broke them. 这场斗争也是一场编写密码者与破译密码者之间的战争，但是这一点甚至对那些熟知这一时期历史的人们来说都是未知的。 采分点① It 指代上一句的 struggle，需明确译出"这场斗争"；② well read about the period 熟知这一时期历史的；③ made codes 编写密码，broke them 破译密码。

entries.title: It listed many documents in code that had been captured from the French army of
entries.text: It listed many documents in code that had been captured from the French army of Spain, and whose secrets had been revealed by the work of George Scovell, an officer in British headquarters. It listed many documents in code that had been captured from the French army of Spain, and whose secrets had been revealed by the work of George Scovell, an officer in British headquarters. 这本书的附录中列出了从西班牙的法军那里缴获的许多密码文件，这些文件的秘密由英国总部的一位军官乔治·斯科维尔（George Scovell）揭露了出来。 采分点① It 指代上文的 appendix 附录；② 两个并列定语从句 that had been captured 和 whose secrets had been revealed 分别修饰 documents；③ an officer in British headquarters 是 George Scovell 的同位语。

entries.text: he could not analyze carefully what this obscure officer may or may not have contributed to that great struggle between nations or indeed tell us anything much about the man himself. he could not analyze carefully what this obscure officer may or may not have contributed to that great struggle between nations or indeed tell us anything much about the man himself. 阿曼（Oman）无法仔细分析这位名不见经传的军官对那场国家间的伟大斗争有没有做出贡献，也确实无法告诉我们任何有关此人的更多事情。 采分点① obscure 此处意为"名不见经传的"；② contribute to 对……做出贡献；③ tell us anything much about 告诉我们关于……的很多事情。

entries.title: There may have been many spies and intelligence officers during the Napoleonic W
entries.text: There may have been many spies and intelligence officers during the Napoleonic Wars, but it is usually extremely difficult to find the material they actually provided or worked on. There may have been many spies and intelligence officers during the Napoleonic Wars, but it is usually extremely difficult to find the material they actually provided or worked on. 在拿破仑战争时期，也许存在很多间谍和情报官员，但通常难以找到他们实际提供或者破译的情报资料。 采分点① There may have been 也许存在；② during the Napoleonic Wars 在拿破仑战争时期；③ they actually provided or worked on 是省略连词的定语从句修饰 material。

entries.text: Just as the code breaking has its wider relevance in the struggle for Spain, so his attempts to make his way up the promotion ladder speak volumes about British society. Just as the code breaking has its wider relevance in the struggle for Spain, so his attempts to make his way up the promotion ladder speak volumes about British society. 正如破解密码对于西班牙之战更为重要，斯科维尔加官进爵的尝试也将英国社会形态展现得淋漓尽致。 采分点① Just as…so… 正如……也一样；② make one's way up the promotion ladder 加官进爵；③ speak volumes about 充分说明/淋漓尽致展现。

entries.title: Write an email to a professor at a British university, inviting him/her to organ
entries.text: Write an email to a professor at a British university, inviting him/her to organize a team to participate in the International Innovation Contest to be held at your university. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. Part A 小作文（10分）— 邀请信 原题指令 Directions Write an email to a professor at a British university, inviting him/her to organize a team to participate in the International Innovation Contest to be held at your university. You should write about 100 words. Do not sign your own name at the end of the email. Use "Li Ming" instead. 【译文】给英国一所大学的教授写一封电子邮件，邀请他/她组建一支队伍，参加在你校举办的国际创新大赛。字数约100词。邮件末尾不要署自己的名字，使用“李明”代替。 题目 写一封邮件给一位英国大学教授，邀请他/她组织一支队伍参加在你校举办的国际创新大赛。约100词，落款Li Ming。 审题 ① 格式：邮件/邀请信；② 语气：正式礼貌；③ 内容：代表委员会邀请、赛事时间地点、期待回复。 参考范文 Dear Professor Bruce, On behalf of the International Innovation Contest Committee, I am writing to invite you to organize a team to participate in the upcoming global innovation competition. The contest will be held in the Hall of the Innovation Center from 2:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. on May 15. The schedule is as follows: an opening ceremony first; then contestants from various countries will present their works revolving around cutting-edge science and technology; finally, awards and certificates will be conferred on the outstanding teams. We believe your participation will bring fresh ideas

entries.text: Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The cartoon shows two students in front of a campus billboard advertising lectures. A girl says, "They're not related to our major, so they won't help." A boy says, "Go and listen; it'll surely do you good." Part B 大作文（20分）— 图画作文 原题指令 Directions Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay, you should 1) describe the drawing briefly, 2) explain its intended meaning, and 3) give your comments. You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. Picture: The cartoon shows two students in front of a campus billboard advertising lectures. A girl says, "They're not related to our major, so they won't help." A boy says, "Go and listen; it'll surely do you good." 【译文】根据下面的图画写一篇160–200词的短文。文中应： 1）简要描述图画；2）说明其寓意；3）给出你的评论。 请在答题卡2上工整书写。 漫画中校园讲座广告牌前，两名学生对话。女生说：“不是我们一个专业的，听了也没有多大用。”男生说：“去听一下，肯定有好处。” 题目 图画：校园讲座广告牌前，两个学生对话。女生说："不是我们一个专业的，听了也没有多大用。"男生说："去听一下，肯定有好处。"要求：简要描述图画、阐释含义、给出评论。160-200词。 审题框架 三段式：①描述图画（两种对待跨专业讲座的态度）；②阐释含义（大学生应广泛涉猎知识而非局限本专业）；③评论（跨学科知识的重要性）。 参考范文 The cartoon captures a familiar campus scene. In front of a billboard advertising various lectures, a girl complains to her friend, "They're not related to our major, so they won't help our study." Her companion replies, "Go and listen; there's bound to be some benefit." Simple as it is, the picture reflects a prevalent mindset: some students limit themselves strictly to their own discipline and dismiss knowledge from other fields. Yet in an era of rapid change, those with broad horizons and multiple skills adapt far better and prove more competitive. As the saying go
